description: Biometric verification wizard that captures client face images, processes a selected national identification document (INE, Passport, or Driver License), validates the face match against the ID using Azure Face API, and records legal contract agreement.

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of identification document provided by the client. Allowed values: 'INE', 'Passport', 'Driver License'.

fields.name: idFrontImageBlobUrl
fields.description: Azure Blob Storage URL of the captured front side of the identification document.

fields.name: clientSelfieBlobUrl
fields.description: Azure Blob Storage URL of the live client camera selfie used for facial validation.

fields.name: confidenceScore
fields.description: The matching confidence rating returned by the face verification AI model.

fields.name: isVerified
fields.description: Flags whether the biometric verification passed the system's threshold requirements.

fields.name: contractAccepted
fields.description: Explicit validation indicating if the client agreed to the contract terms during the wizard process.

fields.name: acceptedAt
fields.description: Timestamp recording exactly when the contract terms were accepted.

relationships.notes: Implicit multi-tenant isolation. Note that companyId is dynamically handled by Stored Procedures during execution and omitted from explicit PRD entry fields.

components.name: DocumentSelectionStep
components.description: IonRadioGroup selecting documentType from: INE, Passport, or Driver License.

components.name: CameraCaptureStep
components.description: Capacitor Camera interface capturing 2 separate images: idFrontImageBlobUrl and clientSelfieBlobUrl.

components.name: BiometricVerificationStep
components.description: Displays matching progress status along with the resulting AI confirmation metric (isVerified).

components.name: ContractAgreementStep
components.description: Presents terms and conditions text bound to an IonCheckbox indicating contractAccepted.

endpoints.description: Accepts temporary image payloads, orchestrates data transmission to the Azure AI validation service, stores verified assets to Azure Blob Storage, and evaluates matching thresholds.
Persists final confirmation state, document references, and legal contract signatures down to the persistence layer.
